submissions.decision-consecutive-stockout-penalty: WITH days AS (SELECT item_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_units < 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY item_code ORDER BY day_no ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS deficient_in_last_three FROM stock_day) SELECT item_code, SUM(deficient_in_last_three = 3) AS charged_days, 70 * SUM(deficient_in_last_three = 3) AS penalty_cents FROM days GROUP BY item_code ORDER BY item_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
submissions.decision-consolidate-inbound-lot-fees: SELECT a.lot_id AS first_lot, b.lot_id AS second_lot, a.lot_cents + b.lot_cents + na.fee_cents + CASE WHEN a.supplier_id = b.supplier_id THEN 0 ELSE nb.fee_cents END AS landed_cents, na.notice_id AS first_notice, nb.notice_id AS second_notice FROM stock_lot AS a JOIN stock_lot AS b ON a.lot_id COLLATE BINARY < b.lot_id AND a.cartons + b.cartons = 10 JOIN supplier_notice AS na ON na.supplier_id = a.supplier_id JOIN supplier_notice AS nb ON nb.supplier_id = b.supplier_id ORDER BY landed_cents, first_lot COLLATE BINARY, second_lot COLLATE BINARY LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-contiguous-party-seat-quote: SELECT p.slip_id, s.seat_no AS first_seat, MAX(c.seat_no) AS last_seat, SUM(c.price_cents) AS total_cents FROM party_slip AS p CROSS JOIN row_chair AS s JOIN row_chair AS c ON c.seat_no BETWEEN s.seat_no AND s.seat_no + (p.party_size - 1) GROUP BY p.slip_id, p.party_size, s.seat_no HAVING COUNT(c.price_cents) = p.party_size ORDER BY total_cents, first_seat LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-corroborate-a-room-attribution: WITH citations AS (SELECT take_id, room_id, MIN(card_id COLLATE BINARY) AS card_id FROM room_card WHERE room_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY take_id, room_id, origin_id), counted AS (SELECT take_id, room_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY take_id, room_id) AS origin_count, card_id FROM citations) SELECT take_id, room_id, origin_count, card_id FROM counted WHERE origin_count >= 2 ORDER BY take_id, room_id, card_id
